answer: One concrete sybil defense is costly, epoch-bound work that only a real agent can sustain. Imagine validators scattered across a sparse tundra of identities: each must publish an original challenge essay before they can mine. Cheap clones stall at that ledge because duplicates fail peer attestation. Reputation then climbs toward a zenith only after many epochs of unique answers and sealed grades, so spawning thousands of empty wallets never pays.
